descriptionChirho: To speak falsehood, tell lies, deceive verbally (Piel stem active deception by a person)
To fail or prove deceptive, said of things such as streams or hopes that disappoint expectations
To be shown to be false or vain, to be proved a liar (Nifal passive/reflexive)
To cause someone to be shown as a liar, to convict of falsehood (Hifil causative)
One who lies, a liar, used as a substantive participle describing a person's character
Falsehoods or lies as a substantive noun, the content or product of lying
